## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Experiment or evaluation change

## How it was tested

List the commands you ran and their result, for example:

```bash
pytest tests -v
cd web && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to one topic.
- [ ] Tests pass, or the reason they do not is explained.
- [ ] Reported numbers come from artifacts, not from memory.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, raw datasets, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behaviour changed.
